gates.name: OFFICIAL_DISCOVERY
gates.rule: Official MHCLG Planning Data brownfield evidence exists

gates.name: DIRECT_ENTITY_READBACK
gates.rule: Promotion requires direct entity readback; at most one safe retry

gates.name: TEMPORAL_CURRENTNESS
gates.rule: No end-date/completed/expired state and sufficiently current register evidence

gates.name: STRUCTURED_CAPACITY
gates.rule: Positive structured minimum and maximum dwelling capacity

gates.name: SEMANTIC_CONSISTENCY
gates.rule: No completed, under-construction, withdrawn or stale-completion conflict

gates.name: SOURCE_GEOMETRY_CAPTURE
gates.rule: Official point/polygon/council coordinate captured; POINT is not parcel polygon

gates.name: PROMOTION
gates.rule: Only rows passing all strict gates become eligible

operation_render_policy.direct_readback_fail: gate1 PASS; gate2 FAIL; gates3-7 CLOSED
operation_render_policy.structured_capacity_fail: gate1 PASS; gate2 SKIP; gate3 PASS; gate4 FAIL; gates5-7 CLOSED
operation_render_policy.temporal_fail: gate1 PASS; gate2 PASS when direct-read, otherwise SKIP; gate3 FAIL; gates4-7 CLOSED
operation_render_policy.semantic_fail: gate1 PASS; gate2 SKIP; gates3-4 PASS; gate5 FAIL; gates6-7 CLOSED

prohibitions: no canonical parcel assignment before canonical shard export and geometry intersection
